<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<script>(function(){try{
var m=localStorage.getItem("lightMode");
if(!m){m="dark";localStorage.setItem("lightMode","dark");}
if(m==="auto"){m=window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches?"dark":"light";}
document.documentElement.className=m;document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",m);
}catch(e){document.documentElement.className="dark";}})();</script>

<script>
window.modules = {};
var htmlcontent = document.querySelector("HTML");
function colorApp() {
let getmode = localStorage.getItem("lightMode") || "dark";
if (getmode === "auto") {
let isDarkMode = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
htmlcontent.setAttribute("class", isDarkMode ? "dark" : "light");
} else {
htmlcontent.setAttribute("class", getmode);
}
}
colorApp();
</script>

<!-- ================= SMMWARRIOR ================= -->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="smmwarrior">
/* ========== WARRIOR CONSOLE — tokens ========== */
html{
--mc:#FF3350;--mc-hover:#FF5C72;--mc-trans:rgba(255,51,80,.10);
--acc:#FF7A3D;
--grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#A80C22 0%,#FF3350 52%,#FF6E4A 100%);
--grad-s:linear-gradient(120deg,#FF3350,#FF6E4A);
--soft:rgba(255,51,80,.10);--line:rgba(255,51,80,.20);
--sky-grad:var(--grad);--sky-soft:var(--soft);--og-grad:var(--grad);
--og-soft:var(--soft);--og-line:var(--line);
--sky-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(168,12,34,.22);--og-shadow:var(--sky-shadow);
--og-glass:rgba(255,255,255,.80);
--main-bg:#FFF6F7;--second-bg:#FFEEF0;--card-bg:#FFFFFF;--title-bg:#FFEFF1;
--border:#F6DDE1;--tc:#1A0A0D;--ts:#8A6A70;
--rail:#FFFFFF;--rail-tc:#1A0A0D;--rail-ts:#8A6A70;--rail-line:#F6DDE1;
--ink:#0C0508;
--r:14px;--rl:20px;
--mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
}
html.dark{
--mc:#FF4A63;--mc-hover:#FF7D90;--mc-trans:rgba(255,74,99,.14);
--acc:#FF8A57;
--grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#8E0A1C 0%,#FF3350 52%,#FF7A3D 100%);
--grad-s:linear-gradient(120deg,#FF3350,#FF7A3D);
--soft:rgba(255,74,99,.12);--line:rgba(255,74,99,.20);
--sky-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
--og-glass:rgba(18,10,13,.82);
--main-bg:#0E0609;--second-bg:#0A0406;--card-bg:#180D11;--title-bg:#211217;
--border:#2C1A20;--tc:#F7EBEE;--ts:#B09AA0;
--rail:#120810;--rail-tc:#F7EBEE;--rail-ts:#B09AA0;--rail-line:#2C1A20;
--ink:#070305;
}
body{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Outfit',sans-serif!important;background:var(--main-bg)!important;color:var(--tc)}
html{background:var(--main-bg)!important}
main{background:transparent!important}
::selection{background:rgba(255,51,80,.26)}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar-corner{background:transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,51,80,.30);border-radius:99px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(255,51,80,.55)}
svg{flex:0 0 auto}

/* ambient */
body#dash::before,body#guest::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
background:
radial-gradient(760px 520px at 82% -12%,rgba(255,51,80,.15),transparent 64%),
radial-gradient(620px 500px at -6% 92%,rgba(255,122,61,.10),transparent 62%),
repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,51,80,.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 9px)}

.btn-primary{background:var(--grad)!important;border:none!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:800;
border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(168,12,34,.30)!important;transition:.16s}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}

/* ================= SIDEBAR ================= */
.sidebar{width:268px!important;background:var(--rail)!important;border-right:1px solid var(--rail-line)!important;
border-radius:0;position:fixed;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;
height:100vh!important;height:100dvh!important;overflow:hidden}
.sidebar::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:2px;height:100%;background:var(--grad);opacity:.55}
.sidebar::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
background:radial-gradient(420px 260px at 108% -4%,rgba(255,51,80,.16),transparent 66%)}
.sidebar>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.sidebar>.menu-toggle,.sidebar-head,.sb-profile{flex:0 0 auto!important}

.sidebar-head{padding:18px 18px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rail-line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.app-logo .badge{display:none}
.app-logo img.big-logo{max-height:36px}
.sidebar-toggle,.menu-toggle{background:var(--soft)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:var(--mc)!important;border-radius:11px!important}
.sidebar-toggle svg,.menu-toggle svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--mc)!important}

/* identity strip */
.sb-profile{margin:14px 14px 6px;padding:0;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;text-align:left;overflow:visible}
.sb-profile::before,.sb-profile::after{display:none!important}
.wid{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:var(--r);
background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--rail-line);position:relative}
html.dark .wid{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.sb-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;min-width:42px;margin:0;padding:2px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);
background:var(--soft);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;box-shadow:none}
.sb-avatar:hover{transform:none;border-color:var(--mc)}
.sb-avatar .btn-avatar{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:0}
.sb-avatar .btn-avatar img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:100%;border-radius:9px;object-fit:cover;display:block;margin:0}
.sb-avatar::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-2px;right:-2px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;
background:#22C55E;border:2px solid var(--card-bg)}
html.dark .sb-avatar::after{border-color:#1A0F13}
.wid-t{min-width:0;flex:1}
.sb-name{font-weight:800;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--rail-tc);line-height:1.2;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:left}
.sb-mail{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--rail-ts);margin:2px 0 0;max-width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:left;padding:0}
.sb-lvl-btn{position:static!important;width:28px;height:28px;min-width:28px;border-radius:9px;
background:var(--soft)!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;color:var(--mc)!important;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none!important;transition:.18s}
.sb-lvl-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.sb-lvl-btn:hover{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:transparent!important;transform:none}

/* balance tile */
.sb-balance{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:2px 10px;
margin:9px 0 0;padding:13px 14px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--ink);color:#fff!important;
text-decoration:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,51,80,.28);box-shadow:none!important}
.sb-balance::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
background:radial-gradient(300px 120px at 100% 0%,rgba(255,51,80,.34),transparent 70%)}
.sb-balance::after{display:none}
.wbal-k{grid-column:1;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.52);position:relative;z-index:1}
.sb-balance b{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:21px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1.1;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sb-bal-plus{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;align-self:center;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
padding:7px 11px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad-s);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;
width:auto;height:auto;position:relative;z-index:1;transition:.18s}
.sb-bal-plus svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.sb-balance:hover .sb-bal-plus{filter:brightness(1.12)}
.wbal-spark{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:22px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;
padding:0 14px;opacity:.16;pointer-events:none}
.wbal-spark s{flex:1;background:#fff;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;text-decoration:none}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(1){height:30%}.wbal-spark s:nth-child(2){height:55%}.wbal-spark s:nth-child(3){height:38%}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(4){height:74%}.wbal-spark s:nth-child(5){height:48%}.wbal-spark s:nth-child(6){height:88%}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(7){height:62%}

/* segmented rank */
.sb-level{margin-top:11px;text-align:left}
.sb-level-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rail-ts);margin-bottom:6px}
.sb-level-row #placePercent{color:var(--mc);font-size:10.5px;font-family:var(--mono)}
.sb-level-bar{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--rail-line);overflow:hidden;position:relative;border:0}
.sb-level-bar::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 calc(12.5% - 2px),var(--rail) calc(12.5% - 2px) 12.5%)}
.sb-level-bar #statusProgress{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--grad-s);width:0;transition:width .8s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}

/* section caption */
.sb-cap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 4px 8px}
.sb-cap span{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rail-ts)}
.sb-cap i{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--rail-line)}

/* menu */
.sidebar-body{flex:1 1 auto!important;min-height:0!important;overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;
padding:14px 14px 24px!important;gap:0!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--mc) transparent;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.sidebar-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
.sidebar-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--mc);border-radius:99px}
.sb-label{display:none!important}
.sidebar-menu-list{padding:0;margin:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
.sidebar-menu-item a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:9px 11px 9px 13px;border-radius:11px;
color:var(--rail-tc);font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;text-decoration:none;position:relative;
border:0;transition:background .16s,color .16s}
.wbar{position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:3px;height:0;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;
background:var(--grad-s);transition:height .2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.sidebar-menu-icon{width:auto!important;height:auto!important;min-width:0!important;background:transparent!important;
border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:var(--rail-ts)!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center;transition:color .16s}
.sidebar-menu-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.sidebar-menu-text{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sidebar-menu-arrow{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mc);opacity:0;transform:scale(.4);transition:.18s;margin-left:auto}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover{background:var(--soft);color:var(--mc);transform:none}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover .sidebar-menu-icon{color:var(--mc)!important;transform:none}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover .wbar{height:16px}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a{background:var(--soft)!important;color:var(--mc)!important;font-weight:800;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .wbar{height:22px}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon{background:transparent!important;color:var(--mc)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}

/* group */
.sb-group{margin-top:16px}
.sb-group-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:100%;padding:7px 4px;background:transparent;border:0;
cursor:pointer;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rail-ts)}
.sb-gicon{width:18px;height:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--mc)}
.sb-gicon svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.sb-gcaret{margin-left:auto;display:flex;color:var(--rail-ts);transition:transform .22s}
.sb-gcaret svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.sb-group.open .sb-gcaret{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sb-group-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.sb-group.open .sb-group-body{max-height:900px}
.sb-group-body .sidebar-menu-list{padding-top:6px}

/* support card */
.sb-help{margin-top:18px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--rl);background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.sb-help::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-24px;top:-24px;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);opacity:.14}
.sb-help-ic{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad-s);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:9px}
.sb-help-ic svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.sb-help b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--rail-tc)}
.sb-help p{margin:3px 0 10px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--rail-ts)}
.sb-help a{display:block;text-align:center;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--line);
font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mc);text-decoration:none;transition:.16s}
html.dark .sb-help a{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.sb-help a:hover{background:var(--grad-s);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}

.sb-out{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;
color:var(--rail-ts);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;transition:.16s}
.sb-out svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.sb-out:hover{background:rgba(255,51,80,.10);color:var(--mc)}

/* ================= HEADER ================= */
.header{height:78px!important;left:268px!important;background:transparent!important;border-bottom:0!important;
backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.header::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:0;height:1px;background:var(--border)}
.header .container-fluid{padding:0 20px;max-width:100%}
.header-row{height:77px!important;gap:12px}
.app-content{padding-top:78px!important;padding-left:268px!important}
.app{padding-bottom:40px}

.header-start{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center!important;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.wnav{min-width:0}
.header .breadcrumb{margin:0;padding:0;background:transparent}
.header .breadcrumb-item{font-size:0}
.header .breadcrumb-item a{font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.5px;color:var(--tc);text-decoration:none;line-height:1.15}
.header .breadcrumb-item::before{display:none!important}
.wnav-sub{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts);letter-spacing:.2px}
.wnav-sub em{font-style:normal;opacity:.5;margin:0 3px}
.wnav-sub b{color:var(--mc);font-weight:700}

.header-end{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.hd-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 14px;
border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;transition:.18s;border:1px solid var(--border);
background:var(--card-bg);color:var(--tc)}
.hd-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.hd-menu{width:40px;padding:0;display:none}
.hd-af{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:transparent!important;
box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(168,12,34,.28)}
.hd-af:hover{filter:brightness(1.09);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.hd-tg:hover{border-color:var(--mc);color:var(--mc)}

.hd-live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:99px;
background:rgba(34,197,94,.10);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.24);color:#16A34A;
font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.2px;white-space:nowrap}
html.dark .hd-live{color:#4ADE80}
.hd-live i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 currentColor;animation:wPulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes wPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(34,197,94,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0)}}

.hd-bal{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;height:40px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:12px;
background:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(255,51,80,.26);text-decoration:none;transition:.18s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hd-bal::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(180px 60px at 100% 0%,rgba(255,51,80,.32),transparent 70%)}
.hd-bal-k{font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.48);position:relative;z-index:1}
.hd-bal b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.15;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hd-bal:hover{border-color:var(--mc)}

.header-end .btn-line-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;
border-radius:12px!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important;
color:var(--tc)!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;transition:.18s;box-shadow:none!important}
.header-end .btn-line-icon:hover{border-color:var(--mc)!important}
.header-end .btn-line-icon .btn-icon{color:var(--mc);font-weight:800}
.btn-chevron svg{width:14px;height:14px;opacity:.55}
.wacc-btn{position:relative}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;margin:0;display:block}
.avatar-dot{position:absolute;left:34px;bottom:7px;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#22C55E!important;
border:2px solid var(--card-bg);z-index:2}

/* ===== dropdowns ===== */
.dd-menu{border-radius:var(--rl)!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important;
box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(21,10,13,.18)!important;padding:8px!important;margin-top:8px!important}
html.dark .dd-menu{box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.66)!important}
.dd-cap{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts);padding:6px 10px 8px}
.dropdown-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto}
.dropdown-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;
font-weight:700;color:var(--tc);text-decoration:none;transition:.14s}
.dropdown-link .icon{width:24px;height:24px;min-width:24px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--soft);color:var(--mc);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.dropdown-link:hover{background:var(--soft);color:var(--mc)}
.dropdown-link.active{background:var(--soft);color:var(--mc)}

/* account panel */
.wacc{min-width:296px!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden}
.acc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:16px 15px;background:var(--grad);position:relative}
.acc-head::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.09) 0 1px,transparent 1px 8px)}
.acc-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc-avatar img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover;margin:0;display:block;border-radius:11px}
.acc-id{min-width:0;flex:1;position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.acc-mail{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:1px}
.acc-chip{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.20);
border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.30);color:#fff;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}

.acc-bal{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:10px;padding:12px 13px;
border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,51,80,.26)}
.acc-bal::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(220px 80px at 100% 0%,rgba(255,51,80,.30),transparent 72%)}
.acc-bal small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc-bal b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc-bal-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad-s);
color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;position:relative;z-index:1}
.acc-bal-btn svg{width:12px;height:12px}

.acc-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;padding:0 10px 10px}
.acc-quick a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:11px 4px;border-radius:12px;
background:var(--main-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--ts);text-decoration:none;transition:.16s}
html.dark .acc-quick a{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.acc-quick a svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--mc)}
.acc-quick a span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--tc)}
.acc-quick a:hover{border-color:var(--mc);transform:translateY(-2px)}

.acc-section{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;
border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ts)}
.lang-switcher{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--tc);font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.lang-switcher svg{width:14px;height:14px;opacity:.6}
.switcher{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--main-bg);border:1px solid var(--border)}
html.dark .switcher{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.switcher-item{width:30px;height:26px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--ts);
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s}
.switcher-item svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.switcher-item.active{background:var(--grad-s)!important;color:#fff!important}

.acc-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.acc-actions .btn-primary{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:40px;
font-size:13px;border-radius:12px}
.acc-actions .btn-primary svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.acc-out{width:40px;height:40px;min-width:40px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:rgba(239,68,68,.10);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.24);color:#EF4444;transition:.16s}
.acc-out svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.acc-out:hover{background:#EF4444;color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.lang-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.lang-header p{margin:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc)}
.lang-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mc);cursor:pointer}
.lang-back svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.lang-drop{padding:6px}
.hidden{display:none!important}


/* ===== single theme toggle ===== */
.wtog{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0;width:58px;height:30px;padding:3px;
border-radius:99px;background:var(--main-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
html.dark .wtog{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.wtog:hover{border-color:var(--mc)}
.wtog-k{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad-s);
box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(255,51,80,.34);transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
html.dark .wtog-k{transform:translateX(28px)}
.wtog svg{position:relative;z-index:1;width:14px;height:14px;flex:0 0 24px;margin:0 2px;transition:color .2s}
.wtog .wtog-s{color:#fff}
.wtog .wtog-m{color:var(--ts)}
html.dark .wtog .wtog-s{color:var(--ts)}
html.dark .wtog .wtog-m{color:#fff}
.wtog-hid{display:none!important}

/* ===== guest header — restore + soft borders ===== */
.mh-menu .menu a{border:1px solid transparent}
.mh-buttons .btn-light{border:1px solid var(--line)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important}
.mh-buttons .btn-light:hover{border-color:var(--mc)!important;color:var(--mc)!important;background:var(--soft)!important}
.mh-buttons .btn-primary{border:1px solid transparent!important}

/* ================= GUEST HEADER (v1 restored) ================= */
/* ---------- Guest header : floating bar (rect, larger) ---------- */
.outside header,header,header .container,header .container-fluid,header .mh-wrapper{background:transparent!important;background-image:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important}
header::before,header::after{display:none!important}
header .container,header .container-fluid{max-width:1384px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px}
.main-header{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid var(--og-line);background:var(--og-glass);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-radius:22px;padding:13px 14px 13px 22px;box-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(229,18,47,.12);min-height:76px}
.main-header .mh-logo img,.main-header img{max-height:46px}
.main-header .btn{border-radius:14px;height:46px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:0 22px;letter-spacing:.01em;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s,filter .18s,border-color .18s,color .18s}
.main-header .btn-light{border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--card-bg);color:var(--tc);box-shadow:none}
.main-header .btn-light:hover{border-color:var(--mc);color:var(--mc);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:none}
.main-header .btn-primary{position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:none!important}
.main-header .btn-primary::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-80%;width:45%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.4),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);animation:tgShine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.main-header .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.07)}
/* theme switch — segmented pill */
.gt-switch{position:relative;background:var(--main-bg)!important;border:1.5px solid var(--border)!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.gt-switch .switcher-item{position:relative;z-index:1;transition:transform .18s,color .18s}
.gt-switch .switcher-item:not(.active):hover{transform:scale(1.12)}
.gt-switch .switcher-item.active{box-shadow:none!important}
.mh-menu .menu a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 15px;transition:.16s;white-space:nowrap}
.mh-menu .menu .navbar-icon{margin:0!important;color:var(--mc);font-size:14px;flex:0 0 auto}
.mh-menu .menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.mh-menu .menu a:hover{color:var(--mc);background:var(--sky-soft)}
.gt-switch{border-radius:13px!important;height:46px!important;padding:6px 12px!important;gap:10px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;overflow:hidden!important;align-items:center!important;display:inline-flex!important}
.gt-switch .switcher-item{width:26px!important;height:26px!important;min-width:26px!important;border-radius:9px!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.gt-switch .switcher-item i{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1!important}
.mh-mtheme{display:none}
@media(max-width:991px){.gt-switch{display:none}}

/* ==== guest mobile nav v4 ==== */
@media(max-width:991px){
header{box-shadow:none!important;border-bottom:0}
.main-header{border-radius:24px;padding:8px 10px 8px 14px}
.mh-menu-wrapper{border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:transparent!important}
.menu-active .mh-menu-wrapper{background:var(--card-bg)!important;border:1px solid var(--og-line)!important;border-radius:24px!important;
box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(20,3,8,.14)!important;padding:12px!important;margin-top:10px;box-sizing:border-box}
.mh-menu .menu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.mh-menu .menu li{margin:0}
.mh-menu .menu li a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--main-bg);color:var(--tc);
font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:.18s;text-decoration:none;box-sizing:border-box}
.mh-menu .menu li a:hover,.mh-menu .menu li a:active{background:var(--sky-soft);border-color:rgba(255,45,70,.35);color:var(--mc);transform:translateX(3px)}
.mh-menu .navbar-icon{width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--sky-soft);color:var(--mc);
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--og-line);transition:.18s}
.mh-menu .menu li a:hover .navbar-icon{background:var(--sky-grad);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.mh-theme-row{display:none}
.mh-mtheme{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:9px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:15px;
background:var(--main-bg);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.mh-mtheme span{font-weight:800;font-size:12px;color:var(--ts);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.mh-buttons{display:flex!important;gap:9px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.mh-buttons .gt-switch{display:none!important}
.mh-buttons #loginTrigger,.mh-buttons .btn-primary,.mh-buttons .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;border-radius:14px;height:46px;box-sizing:border-box;font-weight:800}
.mh-buttons .btn-light{background:var(--main-bg)!important;border:1.5px solid var(--border)!important;color:var(--tc)!important}
.mh-buttons .btn-light:hover{border-color:var(--mc)!important;color:var(--mc)!important}
.mh-menu-btn .btn-light{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--sky-grad)!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none}
.mh-menu-btn .btn-light svg{color:#fff}
.sidebar,.sidebar::before,.sidebar::after{border-radius:0!important}
.app>.header{border-top-left-radius:0!important;border-top-right-radius:0!important}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
.mh-menu .menu{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* ============================================================
==== GUEST HEADER : 992–1120px COMPACT (tablet-landscape) ==
============================================================ */
@media(min-width:992px) and (max-width:1120px){
header .container,header .container-fluid{padding:0 16px!important;max-width:100%!important}
.main-header{margin-top:12px!important;padding:10px 12px 10px 16px!important;min-height:66px!important;border-radius:18px!important}
.main-header .mh-wrapper{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;gap:10px!important}
.main-header .mh-logo img,.main-header img{max-height:34px!important}
.mh-menu-wrapper{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px!important}
.mh-menu{min-width:0}
.mh-menu .menu{gap:2px!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important}
.mh-menu .menu a{font-size:12.5px!important;padding:8px 9px!important;gap:6px!important;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:11px!important}
.mh-menu .menu .navbar-icon{font-size:12.5px!important}
.gt-switch{height:40px!important;padding:5px 8px!important;gap:6px!important;border-radius:12px!important;flex:0 0 auto}
.gt-switch .switcher-item{width:24px!important;height:24px!important;min-width:24px!important;border-radius:8px!important}
.gt-switch .switcher-item i{font-size:10px!important}
.mh-buttons{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:7px!important;flex:0 0 auto}
.main-header .btn{height:40px!important;padding:0 13px!important;font-size:12.5px!important;gap:6px!important;border-radius:12px!important;white-space:nowrap}
.main-header .btn .btn-icon i{font-size:12px!important}
}
@media(min-width:992px) and (max-width:1045px){
.mh-menu .menu li:first-child{display:none} /* duplicate "Sign in" hide */
.mh-menu .menu a{padding:8px 8px!important;font-size:12px!important}
.main-header{padding:9px 10px 9px 14px!important;min-height:62px!important}
.main-header .mh-logo img,.main-header img{max-height:31px!important}
.main-header .btn{height:38px!important;padding:0 12px!important;font-size:12px!important}
.gt-switch{height:38px!important;padding:5px 7px!important}
}


/* ═══════════ TABLET GUEST HEADER : VERTICAL CENTER (992–1120) ═══════════ */
@media(min-width:992px) and (max-width:1120px){
body header .main-header{min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;
padding:10px 14px 10px 18px!important;overflow:visible!important}
body header .main-header .mh-wrapper{width:100%!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;
justify-content:space-between!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;
padding:0!important;margin:0!important;row-gap:0!important;gap:12px!important}
body header .mh-menu-btn{display:none!important}
body header .mh-menu-wrapper{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;
flex:1 1 auto!important;flex-direction:row!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;align-items:center!important;
gap:10px!important;overflow:visible!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important}
body header .mh-menu{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important}
body header .mh-menu .menu{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
body header .mh-menu .menu li{width:auto!important}
body header .mh-buttons{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important}
body header .mh-logo,body header .mh-logo a{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;line-height:0}
}

/* ═══════════ MOBILE : HIDE ADD FUNDS (+) IN HEADER ═══════════ */

/* ---- guest header : soft border on center buttons ---- */
.main-header .btn-light{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,51,80,.36)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important;color:var(--tc)!important}
.main-header .btn-light:hover{border-color:var(--mc)!important;color:var(--mc)!important;background:var(--soft)!important}
.main-header .btn-primary{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24)!important}
.mh-menu .menu a{border:1.5px solid transparent}
.mh-menu .menu a:hover{border-color:rgba(255,51,80,.28)}
@media(max-width:991px){
.mh-buttons .btn-light{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,51,80,.36)!important}
.mh-menu .menu li a{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,51,80,.22)!important}
}
/* single toggle inside guest bar */
.mh-buttons .wtog{margin-right:2px}
@media(max-width:991px){.wtog-desk{display:none!important}.mh-mtheme{display:flex!important}}

/* ================= BOTTOM NAV ================= */
.bottom-bar{background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 -8px 30px rgba(21,10,13,.12)!important;
border-radius:20px;padding:8px 10px;margin:10px}
html.dark .bottom-bar{background:rgba(20,11,15,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 -8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)!important}
.bottom-link{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
color:var(--ts);text-decoration:none;transition:.16s}
.bottom-link i{font-size:17px}
.bottom-link:hover,.bottom-link.active{color:var(--mc)}
.bottom-center .bottom-link{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;
justify-content:center;margin-top:-22px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(168,12,34,.42)}
.bottom-center .bottom-link i{font-size:21px}

/* ================= FOOTER ================= */
footer{margin-top:72px}
.ftx{position:relative;background:var(--second-bg);border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:52px 0 22px;overflow:hidden}
html.dark .ftx{background:var(--second-bg)}
/* ambient effect layer */
.ftx::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
background:
radial-gradient(760px 380px at 6% -14%,rgba(255,51,80,.16),transparent 66%),
radial-gradient(660px 340px at 96% 24%,rgba(255,122,61,.13),transparent 64%),
radial-gradient(520px 300px at 48% 116%,rgba(255,51,80,.10),transparent 66%)}
.ftx::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.5;
background:
repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,var(--line) 0 1px,transparent 1px 11px),
radial-gradient(var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px);
background-size:auto,24px 24px;
mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000,transparent 78%);
-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000,transparent 78%)}
/* floating orbs */
.ftx-cut{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.ftx-cut::before,.ftx-cut::after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(2px);opacity:.14}
.ftx-cut::before{width:280px;height:280px;left:-90px;top:-90px;background:var(--grad);animation:wFloat 14s ease-in-out infinite}
.ftx-cut::after{width:220px;height:220px;right:-70px;bottom:-70px;background:var(--grad-s);animation:wFloat 18s ease-in-out infinite reverse}
@keyframes wFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(22px,-18px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ftx-cut::before,.ftx-cut::after{animation:none}}
.ftx-inner{position:relative;z-index:3;max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:34px}

/* marquee */
.ftx-marq{overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
padding:13px 0;background:var(--card-bg);border-radius:14px;
mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);
-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent)}
html.dark .ftx-marq{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.ftx-marq-t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;white-space:nowrap;width:max-content;animation:wMarq 40s linear infinite}
.ftx-marq-t span{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--ts);text-transform:uppercase}
.ftx-marq-t i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mc);opacity:.8}
@keyframes wMarq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ftx-marq-t{animation:none}}

.ftx-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1.6fr 1fr;gap:42px}

.ftx-logo img{max-height:36px;margin-bottom:14px}
.ftx-desc{font-size:13.2px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ts);margin:0 0 18px;max-width:330px}
.ftx-desc b{color:var(--mc)}
.ftx-metrics{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.ftx-metrics div{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:13px;
background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border)}
html.dark .ftx-metrics div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.ftx-metrics b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--tc)}
.ftx-metrics span{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts);margin-top:2px}
.ftx-social{display:flex;gap:8px}
.ftx-social a{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--mc);transition:.18s}
html.dark .ftx-social a{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.ftx-social a svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.ftx-social a:hover{background:var(--grad-s);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;transform:translateY(-3px);
box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(255,51,80,.30)}

.ftx-links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
/* icon + title on one line */
.ftx-col h4{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.4px;
text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--tc);margin:0 0 15px}
.ftx-col h4 em{width:26px;height:26px;min-width:26px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mc);font-style:normal}
.ftx-col h4 em svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.ftx-col ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.ftx-col ul a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13.2px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts);
text-decoration:none;transition:.16s}
.ftx-col ul a::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mc);opacity:.35;transition:.16s}
.ftx-col ul a:hover{color:var(--mc);transform:translateX(4px)}
.ftx-col ul a:hover::before{opacity:1}

.ftx-join{padding:22px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--line);
position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(255,51,80,.10)}
html.dark .ftx-join{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
.ftx-join::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-44px;top:-44px;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
background:var(--grad);opacity:.16;filter:blur(4px)}
.ftx-join-ic{position:relative;z-index:1;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;background:var(--grad-s);color:#fff;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:13px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(255,51,80,.32)}
.ftx-join-ic svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.ftx-join b{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc)}
.ftx-join p{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:6px 0 16px;font-size:12.6px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ts)}
.ftx-join-btn{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;text-align:center;padding:11px;border-radius:12px;
background:var(--grad);color:#fff!important;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;transition:.18s;
box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,51,80,.28)}
.ftx-join-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.ftx-join-meta{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:14px}
.ftx-join-meta span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts)}
.ftx-join-meta em{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#22C55E;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.18)}

.ftx-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;
padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.ftx-bottom .copyright{font-size:12.4px;color:var(--ts);font-weight:600}
.ftx-bottom .copyright b{color:var(--tc);font-weight:800}
.ftx-badges-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ftx-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10.5px;
font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--mc);background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.ftx-badge svg{width:12px;height:12px}

/* modals / notify keep */
.lvl-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;
background:rgba(7,3,5,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.lvl-modal.show{display:flex}
html.lvl-open,body.lvl-open{overflow:hidden}
.lvl-dialog{width:100%;max-width:980px;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:24px;background:var(--card-bg);
border:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px}
.lvl-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px}
.lvl-head-l{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:16px;color:var(--tc)}
.lvl-ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--grad-s);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.lvl-close{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--ts);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}
.lvl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.lvl-card{padding:14px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--main-bg);border:1px solid var(--border)}
html.dark .lvl-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.lvl-card-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts);padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.lvl-card-top b{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--tc)}
.lvl-card-top em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;color:var(--mc)}
.lvl-card ul{list-style:none;margin:10px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.lvl-card li{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--tc);padding-left:16px;position:relative}
.lvl-card li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mc)}
.lvl-card li.off{opacity:.4;text-decoration:line-through}
.lvl-card li.off::before{background:var(--ts)}
@media(max-width:900px){.lvl-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.lvl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ================= RESPONSIVE ================= */
@media(max-width:1280px){
.hd-live{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:1150px){
.hd-bal{display:none}
.hd-tg span{display:none}
.hd-tg{width:40px;padding:0}
}
@media(max-width:991px){
.sidebar{position:fixed!important;transform:translateX(-100%)!important;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)!important;z-index:1055}
body.sidebar-active .sidebar{transform:translateX(0)!important}
.sidebar-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,3,5,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:1050}
body.sidebar-active .sidebar-overlay{display:block}
body.sidebar-active{overflow:hidden}
.sidebar .menu-toggle,.sidebar .sidebar-toggle{display:none!important}
.header{left:0!important;height:auto!important}
.header-row{height:auto!important;padding:12px 0}
.app-content{padding-left:0!important;padding-top:76px!important}
.hd-menu{display:inline-flex}
.hd-af span{display:none}
.hd-af{width:40px;padding:0}
.hd-acc-name{display:none}
.header .breadcrumb-item a{font-size:17px}
.bottom-bar{display:grid}
.app{padding-bottom:92px}
.mh-menu-btn{display:flex}
.mh-menu-wrapper{height:0;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 100%;transition:.3s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.menu-active .mh-menu-wrapper{height:auto;padding-top:14px}
.mh-menu .menu{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;width:100%}
.mh-menu .menu a{background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);justify-content:center;font-weight:800}
html.dark .mh-menu .menu a{background:var(--soft)}
.mh-menu .menu a:hover{border-color:var(--mc);background:var(--mc-trans)}
.mh-buttons{width:100%}
.mh-buttons .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center}
.mh-mtheme{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ts)}
.gt-switch,.wtog-desk{display:none}
.wtog-mob{display:inline-flex}
.ftx-main{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px}
.ftx-join{grid-column:1/-1}
}
@media(max-width:767px){
.header .container-fluid{padding:0 12px}
.app-content{padding-left:12px!important;padding-right:12px!important}
.header-end{gap:7px}
.hd-btn,.header-end .btn-line-icon{height:38px}
.hd-menu{width:38px}
.header-end .btn-line-icon .btn-text{display:none}
.header-end .btn-line-icon{padding:0 11px}
.ui-dropdown .dropdown-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,3,5,.55);z-index:1090}
.ui-dropdown.show .dropdown-overlay,.ui-dropdown .dropdown-menu.show~.dropdown-overlay{display:block}
.ui-dropdown .dd-menu{position:fixed!important;left:10px!important;right:10px!important;top:auto!important;
bottom:10px!important;transform:none!important;width:auto!important;min-width:0!important;z-index:1100;
max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:24px!important}
body.dd-open,html.dd-open{overflow:hidden!important}
.ftx{padding:44px 0 20px}
.ftx-inner{padding:0 14px;gap:28px}
.ftx-main{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
.ftx-links{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.ftx-desc{max-width:100%}
.ftx-bottom{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
.ftx-badges-row{justify-content:center}
.wacc{min-width:0!important}
.acc-quick{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
.header .breadcrumb-item a{font-size:15.5px}
.wnav-sub{font-size:10px}
.ftx-links{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.ftx-metrics{gap:18px}
}
@media(min-width:992px){
.sidebar-overlay{display:none!important}
.sidebar{transform:none!important}
body.sidebar-passive .sidebar{width:268px}
}

/* ═══════════ SMMWARRIOR — UPDATE PACK (SMMIU style) ═══════════ */

/* ───── 1. THEME BUTTON → round icon (guest header) ───── */
.wtog{width:44px;height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;
background:var(--card-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--border);
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;flex:0 0 auto}
html.dark .wtog{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.wtog:hover{border-color:var(--mc);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.wtog .wtog-k{display:none!important}
.wtog svg{position:static;width:19px;height:19px;flex:none;margin:0;color:var(--tc)}
.wtog .wtog-s{display:none}
.wtog .wtog-m{display:block}
html.dark .wtog .wtog-s{display:block;color:#FFC24A}
html.dark .wtog .wtog-m{display:none}
.wtog-hid{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:991px){.wtog{width:40px;height:40px;min-width:40px}}

/* ───── 2. SIDEBAR : dark crimson rail ───── */
.sidebar{
--rail-tc:#FFF1F3;--rail-ts:#C3A0A9;--rail-line:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12040A 0%,#2A0510 34%,#54091C 68%,#7E0F27 100%)!important;
border-right:0!important}
html:not(.dark) .sidebar{
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12040A 0%,#2A0510 34%,#54091C 68%,#7E0F27 100%)!important}
.sidebar::before{opacity:.9}
.sidebar::after{background:
radial-gradient(420px 300px at 100% -4%,rgba(255,51,80,.22),transparent 66%),
radial-gradient(360px 300px at 0% 104%,rgba(255,122,61,.16),transparent 64%)}
.sidebar-head{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.sidebar-toggle,.menu-toggle{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;color:#fff!important}
.sidebar-toggle svg,.menu-toggle svg{stroke:#fff!important}
.sidebar-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}

/* profile card — same layout, dark-surface colours */
.wid,html.dark .wid{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important}
.sb-avatar{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important}
.sb-avatar::after,html.dark .sb-avatar::after{border-color:#2A0510!important}
.sb-lvl-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;color:#FF8A9B!important}
.sb-balance{background:rgba(0,0,0,.34)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important}
.sb-level-bar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.sb-level-bar::after{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 calc(12.5% - 2px),#3A0713 calc(12.5% - 2px) 12.5%)}
.sb-level-row #placePercent{color:#FF9AAA}

/* ───── 3. MENU : tree rail (SMMIU) ───── */
.sb-cap span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.42)}
.sb-cap i{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)}
.sidebar-menu-list{padding:2px 0 2px 20px!important;position:relative;gap:2px}
.sidebar-menu-list::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:4px;bottom:16px;width:1.5px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:2px}
.sidebar-menu-item{position:relative}
.sidebar-menu-item a{padding:8px 10px 8px 12px;border-radius:12px;gap:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
.sidebar-menu-item a::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-12px;top:50%;width:12px;height:1.5px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);transform:translateY(-50%)}
.wbar{display:none}
.sidebar-menu-icon{width:32px!important;height:32px!important;min-width:32px!important;border-radius:10px!important;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;
color:#E8C7CE!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.18s}
.sidebar-menu-icon svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover .sidebar-menu-icon{background:rgba(255,51,80,.24)!important;border-color:rgba(255,51,80,.36)!important;color:#FF9AAA!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a{background:transparent!important;color:#FF4A63!important;font-weight:800}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a::before{background:#FF4A63}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon{background:rgba(255,51,80,.20)!important;border-color:rgba(255,51,80,.42)!important;color:#FF4A63!important}
.sidebar-menu-arrow{display:none}

/* group head — chip + circular caret */
.sb-group-head{gap:11px;padding:10px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2px;
text-transform:none;color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.sb-gicon{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff}
.sb-gcaret{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.sb-help{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.10)}
.sb-help a{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}
.sb-out{color:rgba(255,255,255,.66)}
.sb-out:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}

/* ───── 4. HEADER : notification + profile (SMMIU) ───── */
.hd-bell{position:relative;width:42px;height:42px;min-width:42px;border-radius:12px;
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--card-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--mc);transition:.18s;text-decoration:none}
html.dark .hd-bell{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.hd-bell svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.hd-bell:hover{border-color:var(--mc);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.hd-bell em{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:99px;
background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(255,51,80,.4)}

.header-end .wallet-mobile{height:42px!important;border-radius:12px!important;
border:1.5px solid var(--line)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important;padding:0 12px!important}
html.dark .header-end .wallet-mobile{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important}
.header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-icon,.header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-text{color:var(--mc)!important;font-weight:800}
.header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-chevron svg{color:var(--mc);opacity:1}

.wacc-btn{height:46px!important;padding:0 10px 0 5px!important;gap:10px!important;
border:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.wacc-btn:hover{background:var(--soft)!important;border:0!important}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px;margin:0;display:block}
.wacc-id{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.15;min-width:0}
.wacc-id .hd-acc-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mc);max-width:150px;
overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.wacc-id small{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts)}
.wacc-btn .avatar-dot{left:33px;bottom:8px}
.wacc-btn .btn-chevron svg{width:15px;height:15px;opacity:.7;color:var(--ts)}

/* ───── 5. MOBILE HEADER : not too thin ───── */
@media(max-width:991px){
body header .main-header{min-height:64px!important;padding:11px 14px!important;
margin-top:12px!important;border-radius:20px!important}
body header .main-header .mh-logo img,body header .main-header img{max-height:36px!important}
body header .mh-wrapper{min-height:42px!important;align-items:center!important}
body header .mh-menu-btn .btn-light{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;min-width:42px!important;border-radius:13px!important}
.mh-mtheme{padding:11px 14px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
body header .main-header{min-height:60px!important;padding:10px 12px!important;border-radius:18px!important}
body header .main-header img{max-height:32px!important}
body header .mh-menu-btn .btn-light{width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-width:40px!important}
.header-end .wallet-mobile{padding:0 10px!important}
.hd-bell{width:38px;height:38px;min-width:38px}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar{width:32px;height:32px}
.wacc-id{display:none}
}

/* ───── 6. FOOTER : soft slanted top edge ───── */
footer{margin-top:0;position:relative}
.ftx{padding:74px 0 22px!important;border-top:0!important;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card-bg) 0%,var(--main-bg) 58%,var(--second-bg) 100%)!important}
/* slanted divider ribbon */
.ftx-cut{position:absolute!important;top:0;left:-2%;right:-2%;height:90px;inset:auto!important;
pointer-events:none;overflow:visible!important;z-index:4}
.ftx-cut::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:70px;
background:var(--main-bg);transform:skewY(-1.6deg);transform-origin:0 0;
border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);animation:none!important;
width:auto;border-radius:0;filter:none;opacity:1}
.ftx-cut::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:70px;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,51,80,.10),transparent 78%);
transform:skewY(-1.6deg);transform-origin:0 0;animation:none!important;
width:auto;border-radius:0;filter:none;opacity:1}
.ftx::before{background:
radial-gradient(820px 400px at 6% -4%,rgba(255,51,80,.18),transparent 66%),
radial-gradient(700px 360px at 95% 26%,rgba(255,122,61,.15),transparent 64%),
radial-gradient(560px 320px at 50% 114%,rgba(255,51,80,.12),transparent 66%)}
@media(max-width:767px){
.ftx{padding:58px 0 18px!important}
.ftx-cut{height:60px}
.ftx-cut::before,.ftx-cut::after{height:48px;transform:skewY(-2.4deg)}
}


/* ═══════════ SMMWARRIOR — PACK 2 ═══════════ */

/* ───── SIDEBAR : icons visible, active distinct ───── */
.sidebar-menu-icon{color:#FFD3DB!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important}
.sidebar-menu-item a{color:#F3DDE2}
.sidebar-menu-item a:hover .sidebar-menu-icon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.24)!important;color:#fff!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a{color:#FF6E86!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon{background:#FF3350!important;border-color:#FF6E86!important;color:#fff!important;
box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(255,51,80,.5)!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon svg{stroke:#fff!important}
.sidebar-menu-list::before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.sidebar-menu-item a::before{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}

/* brand row : collapse chevron pinned left of logo */
.sidebar-head{padding:16px 16px 12px;gap:12px;flex-direction:row-reverse;justify-content:flex-end}
.sidebar-head .wb{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center}
.sidebar .sidebar-toggle,.sidebar .menu-toggle{position:static!important;width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;
border-radius:10px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important;
display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;opacity:1!important;pointer-events:auto!important;
top:auto!important;right:auto!important;transform:none!important;margin:0!important;z-index:2}
.sidebar .sidebar-toggle svg,.sidebar .menu-toggle svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:#fff!important}
.app-logo img.big-logo{max-height:34px}

/* ───── BALANCE : equaliser ───── */
.wbal-spark{left:12px;right:12px;height:20px;gap:2px;opacity:.55}
.wbal-spark s{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FF7D90,#FF3350);border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
height:30%;transform-origin:bottom;animation:wEq 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(1){animation-duration:.72s;animation-delay:0s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(2){animation-duration:.95s;animation-delay:.08s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(3){animation-duration:.62s;animation-delay:.16s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(4){animation-duration:1.1s;animation-delay:.04s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(5){animation-duration:.82s;animation-delay:.22s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(6){animation-duration:.68s;animation-delay:.12s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(7){animation-duration:1.02s;animation-delay:.3s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(8){animation-duration:.76s;animation-delay:.06s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(9){animation-duration:.9s;animation-delay:.18s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(10){animation-duration:.66s;animation-delay:.26s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(11){animation-duration:1.06s;animation-delay:.1s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(12){animation-duration:.8s;animation-delay:.2s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(13){animation-duration:.7s;animation-delay:.14s}
.wbal-spark s:nth-child(14){animation-duration:.98s;animation-delay:.02s}
@keyframes wEq{from{transform:scaleY(.25)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wbal-spark s{animation:none}}
.sb-balance{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,0,0,.5),rgba(90,8,24,.55))!important;
border-color:rgba(255,51,80,.30)!important;overflow:hidden}

/* ───── SIDEBAR DOCK (support card, logout removed) ───── */
.sidebar{padding-bottom:0}
.sb-dock{flex:0 0 auto!important;padding:12px 14px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.10),rgba(0,0,0,.30));position:relative;z-index:2}
.sb-dock .sb-help{display:block;margin:0;padding:13px;border-radius:16px;text-decoration:none;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);transition:.18s}
.sb-dock .sb-help:hover{background:rgba(255,51,80,.16);border-color:rgba(255,51,80,.34)}
.sb-help::after{display:none}
.sb-help-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.sb-help-ic{width:30px;height:30px;min-width:30px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0}
.sb-help-ic svg{width:16px;height:16px}

.sb-help p{margin:0 0 10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5}
.sb-help-btn{display:block;text-align:center;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grad);
color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.sb-out{display:none!important}
.sidebar-body{padding-bottom:14px!important}

/* ───── HEADER ───── */
.header{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;background:var(--main-bg)!important}
.header-row{gap:10px}
.cur-ic{width:26px;height:26px;min-width:26px;border-radius:8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:var(--grad);color:#fff!important}
.cur-ic .btn-icon{color:#fff!important;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.header-end .wallet-mobile{gap:9px!important}

/* ───── DROPDOWNS : full content, wider, scrollable ───── */
.dd-menu{max-height:min(560px,78vh);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.dropdown-menu.dd-menu[aria-labelledby="dropdownCurrency"]{min-width:264px!important;padding:10px 12px!important}
#currencies-list{max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 2px}

.wacc::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,#currencies-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--mc);border-radius:99px}

/* language panel */
.lang-header{padding:12px 14px;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card-bg);z-index:2}
.lang-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 12px 6px 6px;border-radius:99px;
background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mc);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}

display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

.lang-drop{max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 8px 10px}

/* ───── MOBILE ───── */

.hd-menu{display:inline-flex!important;width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-width:40px!important;
border-radius:12px!important;background:var(--grad)!important;border:0!important;color:#fff!important;padding:0!important}
.hd-menu svg{stroke:#fff!important;width:19px;height:19px}

}

/* dropdowns escape the header on mobile → bottom sheet over page */
@media(max-width:991px){
.header,.header-row,.container-fluid,.app,.app-content{
backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;filter:none!important;transform:none!important}
.ui-dropdown{position:static!important}
.ui-dropdown .dropdown-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(7,3,5,.6);z-index:1190}
.ui-dropdown.show .dropdown-overlay,.ui-dropdown .dropdown-menu.show~.dropdown-overlay{display:block}
.ui-dropdown .dd-menu{position:fixed!important;left:10px!important;right:10px!important;
top:auto!important;bottom:10px!important;transform:none!important;margin:0!important;
width:auto!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:none!important;
max-height:82vh!important;overflow-y:auto!important;z-index:1200!important;border-radius:24px!important;
box-shadow:0 -22px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
body.dd-open,html.dd-open{overflow:hidden!important}
}

/* ───── FOOTER : premium dark space (SMMIU style) ───── */
footer{margin-top:0}
.ftx{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:78px 0 26px!important;border-top:0!important;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#070204 0%,#0D0308 26%,#2A0510 62%,#6E0C22 88%,#A3122F 100%)!important}
html.dark .ftx{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#050103 0%,#0A0206 26%,#25040E 62%,#640A1F 88%,#96102B 100%)!important}
/* top glow edge */
.ftx-cut{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden!important;z-index:1}
.ftx-cut::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-10%;right:-10%;height:2px;width:auto;border-radius:0;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#FF3350 18%,#FF7D90 50%,#FF3350 82%,transparent);
filter:blur(.5px);opacity:.95;animation:none}
.ftx-cut::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-140px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
width:1200px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,51,80,.55),transparent 70%);
filter:blur(30px);opacity:.8;animation:none}
/* star field + bottom arc */
.ftx::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
background:
radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 12% 22%,rgba(255,255,255,.85),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 28% 46%,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.6px 1.6px at 44% 16%,rgba(255,255,255,.75),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.1px 1.1px at 61% 58%,rgba(255,255,255,.55),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 76% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.8),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 88% 62%,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.3px 1.3px at 34% 76%,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 68% 84%,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 18% 66%,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 92% 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.7),transparent);
animation:ftxTwinkle 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes ftxTwinkle{from{opacity:.45}to{opacity:.95}}
.ftx::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-560px;transform:translateX(-50%);
width:180%;height:700px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,90,120,.55),rgba(255,51,80,.18) 62%,transparent 74%);
box-shadow:0 -2px 0 0 rgba(255,160,180,.55) inset;opacity:.9}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ftx::before{animation:none}}
.ftx-inner{position:relative;z-index:3}

/* footer text on dark */
.ftx-marq{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important}
.ftx-marq-t span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.ftx-desc{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}

.ftx-social{margin-bottom:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.ftx-metrics{gap:10px}
.ftx-metrics div{align-items:center!important;text-align:center;padding:13px 10px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important}

.ftx-metrics span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.ftx-col h4{color:#fff}

.ftx-col ul a:hover{color:#fff}
.ftx-col ul a::before{background:#FF4A63}
.ftx-join{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;
box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important}
.ftx-join-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.ftx-join-ic{margin:0!important}
.ftx-join b{color:#fff;margin:0}
.ftx-join p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.ftx-join-meta span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.ftx-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.ftx-bottom .copyright{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.ftx-bottom .copyright b{color:#fff}
.ftx-badge{color:#fff!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)!important}
@media(max-width:767px){
.ftx{padding:60px 0 20px!important}
.ftx-metrics{gap:8px}
.ftx-social a{width:36px;height:36px}
}


/* ═══════════ SMMWARRIOR — PACK 3 (fixes) ═══════════ */

/* 1 ▸ hide the page's own floating theme pill (we drive it from the header) */
[data-w-hidden="1"]{position:fixed!important;left:-9999px!important;top:-9999px!important;
opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;visibility:hidden!important}

/* 2 ▸ kill the stray red blob: #notify only shows when active */
#notify{display:none!important}
#notify.show,#notify.active,#notify[style*="display: block"],#notify[style*="display:block"]{
display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:22px;
transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 18px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;
font-weight:800;font-size:13px;z-index:2200;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(255,51,80,.4)}

/* 3 ▸ sidebar : active icon clearly readable + calm scrollbar */
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon{background:#fff!important;border-color:#fff!important;
color:#C2102A!important;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active .sidebar-menu-icon svg{stroke:#C2102A!important;color:#C2102A!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a{color:#FFC2CC!important}
.sidebar-menu-item.active a::before{background:#fff}
.sidebar-menu-arrow{display:none!important}
.sidebar-body{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28) transparent}
.sidebar-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
.sidebar-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)!important;border-radius:99px}
.sidebar::before{opacity:.35;width:1px}

/* 4 ▸ currency pill — proper size, no giant blob */
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile{height:42px!important;padding:0 11px!important;gap:8px!important;
border-radius:12px!important;border:1.5px solid var(--line)!important;background:var(--card-bg)!important}
html.dark body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .cur-ic{width:24px!important;height:24px!important;min-width:24px!important;
max-width:24px!important;max-height:24px!important;border-radius:7px!important;flex:0 0 24px!important;
display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
background:var(--grad)!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;overflow:hidden}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .cur-ic .btn-icon,
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile #curSym{width:auto!important;height:auto!important;min-width:0!important;
background:none!important;background-color:transparent!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;
box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;
color:#fff!important;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px!important;font-weight:800!important;line-height:1!important}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-text#curCode{color:var(--tc)!important;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-chevron{width:auto!important;height:auto!important;background:none!important;border:0!important}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-chevron svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--ts);opacity:.8}

/* 5 ▸ MOBILE : burger must win over panel css */
@media(max-width:991px){
body .app .header .header-row .header-start .hd-menu,
body .header .hd-menu.sidebar-toggle,
body .hd-menu{
display:inline-flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;
position:static!important;top:auto!important;right:auto!important;left:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;
transform:none!important;margin:0!important;
width:40px!important;height:40px!important;min-width:40px!important;padding:0!important;
align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
border-radius:12px!important;background:var(--grad)!important;border:0!important;
color:#fff!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;z-index:5}
body .hd-menu svg{stroke:#fff!important;color:#fff!important;width:19px!important;height:19px!important;display:block!important}
body .hd-menu::before,body .hd-menu::after{display:none!important}

/* header height + no dead gap under it */
body .app .header{height:64px!important;min-height:64px!important;padding:0!important}
body .app .header .container-fluid{padding:0 10px!important;height:64px!important;display:flex;align-items:center}
body .app .header .header-row{height:64px!important;padding:0!important;gap:8px!important;width:100%}
body .app .app-content{padding-top:64px!important}
body .app{padding-bottom:24px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
body .hd-menu{width:38px!important;height:38px!important;min-width:38px!important}
body .app .header,body .app .header .container-fluid,body .app .header .header-row{height:60px!important;min-height:60px!important}
body .app .app-content{padding-top:60px!important}
body .header .header-end{gap:6px!important}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile{height:36px!important;padding:0 8px!important}
body .header .header-end .wallet-mobile .btn-text#curCode{font-size:11.5px}
.hd-bell{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important}
.hd-tg{width:36px!important;height:36px!important;min-width:36px!important;padding:0!important}
.hd-tg span{display:none!important}
.wacc-btn .btn-avatar{width:30px;height:30px}
}

/* 6 ▸ FOOTER : starry sky, inside the cards too */
.ftx{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#060104 0%,#0B0207 24%,#240410 60%,#6B0A20 87%,#A0112E 100%)!important}
.ftx::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;opacity:.9;
background-repeat:repeat;background-size:340px 340px;
background-image:
radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 20px 30px,rgba(255,255,255,.9),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 90px 120px,rgba(255,255,255,.65),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.7px 1.7px at 160px 60px,rgba(255,255,255,.85),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.1px 1.1px at 230px 180px,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.6px 1.6px at 300px 90px,rgba(255,255,255,.8),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.3px 1.3px at 55px 250px,rgba(255,255,255,.7),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 200px 300px,rgba(255,255,255,.55),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 310px 240px,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 130px 210px,rgba(255,255,255,.5),transparent);
animation:ftxTwinkle 4.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes ftxTwinkle{from{opacity:.5}to{opacity:1}}

/* star field inside footer cards */
.ftx-join,.ftx-metrics div,.ftx-marq{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ftx-join::before,.ftx-metrics div::before,.ftx-marq::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
background-repeat:repeat;background-size:150px 150px;opacity:.75;
background-image:
radial-gradient(1.3px 1.3px at 18px 24px,rgba(255,255,255,.85),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.1px 1.1px at 78px 62px,rgba(255,255,255,.6),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 120px 30px,rgba(255,255,255,.75),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.1px 1.1px at 46px 112px,rgba(255,255,255,.55),transparent),
radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 128px 122px,rgba(255,255,255,.65),transparent);
animation:ftxTwinkle 5.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.ftx-join>*,.ftx-metrics div>*,.ftx-marq>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.ftx-join{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.ftx-metrics div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important}

/* bottom red arc */
.ftx::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-600px;transform:translateX(-50%);
width:190%;height:760px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,110,138,.6),rgba(255,51,80,.2) 60%,transparent 73%);
box-shadow:0 -2px 0 0 rgba(255,180,196,.6) inset}

/* 7 ▸ guest theme button — always tappable, never hidden */
.wtog{z-index:3;position:relative}


/* ═══════════ SMMWARRIOR — PACK 4 ═══════════ */

/* 1 ▸ sidebar head : no chevron, logo left */
.sidebar-head{flex-direction:row!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;padding:18px 16px 14px}
.sidebar .sidebar-toggle,.sidebar .menu-toggle{display:none!important}
.app-logo img.big-logo{max-height:36px}

/* 2 ▸ notification : soft dot, no number */
.hd-bell{border-radius:13px}
.hd-bell svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.hd-bell .hd-dot{position:absolute;top:8px;right:9px;width:8px;height:8px;min-width:0;padding:0;border-radius:50%;
background:#FF3350;border:2px solid var(--card-bg);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,51,80,.55);
animation:wDot 2.2s infinite;font-size:0}
html.dark .hd-bell .hd-dot{border-color:#180D11}
@keyframes wDot{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,51,80,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(255,51,80,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,51,80,0)}}

/* 3 ▸ account dropdown : solid paint (no white flash), status chip */
.dd-menu,.wacc{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;
background:var(--card-bg)!important;will-change:auto!important;contain:none!important;
content-visibility:visible!important}
.acc-head{background:var(--grad)!important;background-color:#C2102A!important;padding:15px 14px}
.acc-head::after{display:none!important}
.acc-chip{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.34);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.9px}
.acc-quick{padding:12px 10px}
.wacc{min-width:318px!important}

/* 4 ▸ level modal close */
.lvl-close{width:36px;height:36px;min-width:36px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--soft);color:var(--mc);cursor:pointer;transition:.16s;padding:0;font-size:0}
.lvl-close svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.lvl-close:hover{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.lvl-head{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card-bg);z-index:3;padding:4px 2px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

/* 5 ▸ guest : theme button red border + signup icon white */
.wtog{border:1.5px solid rgba(255,51,80,.45)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(255,51,80,.14)}
.wtog:hover{border-color:var(--mc)!important;background:var(--soft)!important}
.wtog svg{color:var(--mc)!important}
html.dark .wtog .wtog-s{color:#FFC24A!important}
.main-header .btn-primary .btn-icon,.main-header .btn-primary .btn-icon i,
.mh-buttons .btn-primary .btn-icon,.mh-buttons .btn-primary .btn-icon i{color:#fff!important;opacity:1!important}
.main-header .btn-primary .btn-icon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)!important;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;
display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px}

/* guest mobile menu : red so it reads in light mode */
