<!-- Main variables *content* -->
<script>
(function(){
var h=document.documentElement;
function pick(){
var v=null;try{v=localStorage.getItem('lightMode');}catch(e){}
if(v==='light')return 'light';
if(v==='dark')return 'dark';
var b=document.body;
var cl=(' '+(h.className||'')+' '+(b?b.className||'':'')+' ').toLowerCase();
if(/\s(dark|dark-mode|darkmode|theme-dark|nightmode)\s/.test(cl))return 'dark';
if(/\s(light|light-mode|lightmode|theme-light)\s/.test(cl))return 'light';
var a=h.getAttribute('data-theme')||h.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')||'';
if(a==='dark'||a==='light')return a;
return 'dark';
}
h.setAttribute('data-oddm',pick()==='dark'?'1':'0');
})();
</script>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* ══ TOKENS ══ */
.od{
--p:#E11020;--p2:#FF3B42;--ac:#FF7A3D;
--g:linear-gradient(135deg,#A50C16,#E11020 52%,#FF3B42);
--sf:rgba(225,16,32,.10);--ln:rgba(225,16,32,.28);
--tc:#150A0D;--ts:#7A6A6E;--bd:rgba(20,10,13,.10);
--glass:#FFFFFF;--field:#F6F7F9;--tt:rgba(225,16,32,.05);
--ok:#16A34A;--wr:#D97706;
--mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--tc);position:relative;z-index:0;display:block;overflow-x:clip;
min-height:calc(100vh - 140px);min-height:calc(100dvh - 140px);
margin:0!important;padding:22px 26px calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;max-width:100%}
.od[data-dm="1"]{
--tc:#F6ECEE;--ts:#A9969B;--bd:rgba(255,255,255,.11);
--sf:rgba(255,74,99,.14);--ln:rgba(255,74,99,.26);
--glass:#150C10;--field:#0E070A;--tt:rgba(255,74,99,.07);
--ok:#4ADE80;--wr:#FBBF24}
.od>.container.container-dashboard,
.od>.container-fluid.container-dashboard{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;max-width:100%!important}

/* ══ FULL-SCREEN BACKGROUND ══ */
html{background-image:url("https://storage.perfectcdn.com/eq86bz/owkhj64fsn7fayf6.png")!important; /* od-photo-url */
background-size:cover!important;background-position:center top!important;
background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-attachment:fixed!important}
body{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--odv1,rgba(246,247,250,.72)) 0%,var(--odv2,rgba(246,247,250,.60)) 30%,
var(--odv3,rgba(246,247,250,.76)) 72%,var(--odv4,rgba(246,247,250,.90)) 100%)!important;
background-attachment:fixed!important;background-color:transparent!important}
html[data-oddm="1"] body{--odv1:rgba(4,4,6,.68);--odv2:rgba(4,4,6,.56);--odv3:rgba(4,4,6,.72);--odv4:rgba(4,4,6,.88)}
@media(max-width:900px){html,body{background-attachment:scroll!important}}

/* layout.txt paints an ambient layer on body#dash::before — a red glow plus 115deg
streaks, position:fixed z-index:-1, so it sits ON TOP of the photo above.
Switched off here only; the #dash id out-specifies the original rule. */
html body#dash.od-live::before,
html body.od-live::before{content:none!important;display:none!important;background:none!important}
@media(max-width:991px){
body.od-live .app-content{padding-left:0!important;padding-right:0!important}
}

.od *{box-sizing:border-box}
.od-in{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}

/* ══ HERO CARD — warrior banner ══ */
.od-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:32px 34px 30px;border-radius:20px;
background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--bd)}
/* the artwork gets its own layer so dark mode can filter it — a background-image
set on the card itself cannot be filtered without hitting the content too */
.od-hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
background-image:url("https://storage.perfectcdn.com/eq86bz/hjkwaknei1odoy9d.png"); /* od-hero-url */
background-size:cover;background-position:right center;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-hero{background:transparent}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-hero-bg{filter:brightness(.62) contrast(1.06) saturate(1.35)}
.od-hero-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.93) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.80) 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 68%,transparent 100%)}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-hero-scrim{
background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(16,9,12,.80) 0%,rgba(16,9,12,.58) 38%,rgba(16,9,12,.16) 66%,transparent 100%)}
.od-hero-in{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:720px;text-align:center}

.od-eyb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 13px 6px 10px;border-radius:999px;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);
font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.od-eyb em{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ADE80}
.od-hero h1{margin:14px auto 8px;max-width:600px;font-size:clamp(21px,2.7vw,31px);font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:-.026em;line-height:1.2;color:var(--tc)}
.od-hero h1 span{color:var(--p)}
.od-hero p{margin:0 auto;max-width:520px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ts)}
.od-hero p b{color:var(--tc);font-weight:800}

/* stat row — bare tiles with hairline dividers, no inner panel */
.od-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:660px}
.od-stat{position:relative;padding:4px 10px;text-align:center;min-width:0;border-left:1px solid var(--bd)}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-stat{border-left-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-stat>i{background:rgba(255,74,99,.20);border-color:rgba(255,120,140,.34)}
.od-stat:first-child{border-left:0}
.od-stat>i{width:46px;height:46px;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);font-size:17px;transition:.18s}
.od-stat .v{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:clamp(15px,1.9vw,20px);font-weight:800;
line-height:1;color:var(--tc);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.od-stat .k{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ts)}

/* ══ PLATFORM RAIL ══ */
.od-rail{padding:15px 17px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.od-rail-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px;
font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts)}
.od-rail-h em{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g)}
.od-rail-h s{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--bd);text-decoration:none}
#noc-filter{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.noc-button{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
min-width:0;height:52px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;
background:var(--field);border:1.5px solid var(--bd);color:var(--tc);font-family:inherit;transition:.18s}
.noc-button .icons{display:grid;place-items:center;width:21px;height:21px;flex:0 0 21px;
background:none;border:0;padding:0}
.noc-button .icons img,.noc-button img.man{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.noc-button>i{font-size:17px;line-height:1;flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--p);transition:.18s}
.noc-button .filter_txt{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;
white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-width:0}
.noc-button:hover{border-color:var(--ln);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.noc-button.active,.noc-button.selected{background:var(--g);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.noc-button.active>i,.noc-button.selected>i{color:#fff}
/* brand tints for the icon-font buttons */
.noc-button.linkedin>i{color:#0A66C2}
.noc-button.discord>i{color:#5865F2}
.noc-button.twitch>i{color:#9146FF}
.noc-button.soundcloud>i{color:#FF5500}
.od[data-dm="1"] .noc-button.linkedin>i{color:#4DA3E8}

/* ══ GRID ══ */
.no-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.72fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:13px;align-items:start}
.no-left,.no-right{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}

/* ══ SEARCH ══ */
.neworder-top{padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.neworder-top .form-group{margin:0}
#new-order-search .input-wrapper{position:relative}
.od #template-input{width:100%;height:54px;border-radius:14px;border:1.5px solid var(--bd);
background:var(--field);padding:0 108px 0 50px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--tc);
outline:0;font-family:inherit;transition:.18s}
.od #template-input::placeholder{color:var(--ts);opacity:.7}
.od #template-input:focus{border-color:var(--p)}
.input-wrapper__prepend{color:var(--p)!important;font-size:15px;z-index:2}
/* right-hand affordances */
.od-sx{position:absolute;top:50%;right:14px;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:3;
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;pointer-events:none}
.od-sx .hint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:8px;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);
font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap}
.od-sx .clr{pointer-events:auto;display:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;
background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--ts);font-size:11px;
align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:.18s}
.od-sx .clr:hover{border-color:var(--ln);color:var(--p)}
.od-searching .od-sx .clr{display:inline-flex}
.od-searching .od-sx .hint{display:none}
.od-sx .spin{display:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;
align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--p);font-size:12px}
.od-hunting .od-sx .spin{display:inline-flex}
.od-hunting .od-sx .clr,.od-hunting .od-sx .hint{display:none}
@keyframes odSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.od-sx .spin i{animation:odSpin .8s linear infinite}

/* ══ FORM CARD ══ */
.od-card{border-radius:20px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--bd);overflow:hidden}
.np-sec+.np-sec{border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
.np-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:18px 22px 0}
.np-step{width:34px;height:34px;min-width:34px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);
font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.np-ttl{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--tc)}
.np-sub{margin-top:2px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts);line-height:1.6}
.np-body{padding:16px 22px 20px}
.od .form-group{margin:0 0 13px}
.od .form-group:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.od .control-label,.od .form-label{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;
text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts);margin-bottom:7px}
.od .form-control,.od select.form-control,.od textarea.form-control{
width:100%;min-height:48px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--bd);background:var(--field);
padding:12px 14px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--tc);outline:0;font-family:inherit;transition:.18s}
.od .form-control::placeholder{color:var(--ts);opacity:.65}
.od .form-control:focus{border-color:var(--p)}
.od textarea.form-control{min-height:130px;line-height:1.8;resize:vertical}
.od select.form-control{cursor:pointer;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;padding-right:38px;
background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,currentColor 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,currentColor 50%,transparent 50%);
background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 21px,calc(100% - 15px) 21px;background-size:5px 5px,5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat}

/* service description — raw panel (kept as the fallback) */
#service_description .panel-body{border-radius:13px;background:var(--tt);border:1px solid var(--ln);
padding:14px 16px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--tc);max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto}
#service_description .panel-body a{color:var(--p);font-weight:700}
#service_description .panel-body img{max-width:100%;border-radius:9px}
/* keep the raw text from flashing before the parser rewrites it */
#service_description .panel-body{visibility:hidden}
#service_description .panel-body.od-ready,#desc-panel-body.od-ready{visibility:visible}
#desc-panel-body.od-ready{background:none;border:0;padding:0;max-height:none;overflow:visible}

/* service description — parsed spec tiles */
.od-spec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}
.od-spec-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;
background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--bd);min-width:0}
.od-spec-row>i{width:30px;height:30px;min-width:30px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);font-size:12px}
.od-spec-row .k{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.11em;
text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.od-spec-row .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc);
text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:58%}
.od-spec-row.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.od-spec-row.wide .v{white-space:normal;text-align:right;max-width:70%;line-height:1.6}
.od-note{grid-column:1/-1;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:13px;
background:var(--tt);border:1px dashed var(--ln)}
.od-note b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--p);margin-bottom:9px}
.od-note ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.od-note li{position:relative;padding-left:15px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ts)}
.od-note li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:8px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--p)}
.od-note li b{display:inline;color:var(--tc);margin:0}
.od .hidden{display:none!important}
.od .fields:not(.hidden){display:block}
#avg-completed-times-wrap{margin-top:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;
background:var(--tt);border:1px dashed var(--ln)}
#avg-completed-times-wrap .form-label{margin-bottom:9px}
#avg-completed-times-wrap .form-label i{color:var(--p);margin-right:5px}
/* the "· avg 1h 48m" tail sits inside the label but keeps sentence casing */
#avg-completed-times-wrap .form-label .od-avg{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;
text-transform:none;color:var(--tc)}
/* six cells, all identical in size — three across, two across on mobile */
#avg-completed-times{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
#avg-completed-times>*{height:38px;min-width:0}
#avg-completed-times .badge{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
width:100%;margin:0!important;padding:0 10px!important;
background:var(--g)!important;color:#fff!important;
font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:800!important;font-size:11px!important;
line-height:1!important;border-radius:10px!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important;
white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#avg-completed-times span,#avg-completed-times div{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
padding:6px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--bd);
font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ts)}
/* the empty / error line spans the whole grid instead of sitting in one cell */
#avg-completed-times .text-muted,#avg-completed-times .text-danger{
grid-column:1/-1;height:auto!important;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;
background:none;border:0;padding:0}
#avg-completed-times .text-muted{color:var(--ts)}
#avg-completed-times .text-danger{color:#EF4444;font-weight:700}
/* loading shimmer — themed, so it works in dark mode too.
FIX 1 (v2): "#avg-completed-times span" above is an ID selector, so it beat
.od-skel-i and the shimmer never showed. Matched on the id here so it wins. */
@keyframes odSkel{0%{background-position:200% 0}100%{background-position:-200% 0}}
#avg-completed-times .od-skel-i,.od-skel-i{border-radius:10px;padding:0!important;border:0!important;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--field) 25%,var(--tt) 37%,var(--field) 63%)!important;
background-size:200% 100%!important;animation:odSkel 1.2s infinite}

/* ══ CHECKOUT ══ */
.no-sum{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px;margin-bottom:15px}
.sc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px 16px;border-radius:15px;
background:var(--field);border:1.5px solid var(--bd)}
.sc>i{width:38px;height:38px;min-width:38px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);font-size:14px}
.sc .sl{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ts)}
.sc .sv{margin-top:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;color:var(--tc)}
.sc.charge{background:var(--g);border-color:transparent}
.sc.charge>i{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.26);color:#fff}
.sc.charge .sl{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.sc.charge .sv{color:#fff}
.od #price-box{margin:0}
.od #charge{width:100%;min-height:0;height:auto;padding:0;margin:0;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;
font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:#fff!important;outline:0;cursor:default}
.form-buttons{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}
.control-label.terms{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:0;
font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--ts);line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer}
.control-label.terms input{width:17px;height:17px;min-width:17px;margin:1px 0 0;accent-color:var(--p);cursor:pointer}
.control-label.terms a{color:var(--p);font-weight:800;text-decoration:none}
.od .btn-primary{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%;height:54px;
border:0!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:var(--g)!important;color:#fff!important;
font-family:inherit!important;font-size:14.5px!important;font-weight:800!important;cursor:pointer;
box-shadow:none!important;transition:transform .18s,filter .18s}
.od .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.08)}

/* ══ ALERTS ══ */
.od .alert{position:relative;border-radius:14px;padding:15px 44px 15px 17px;margin:0 0 13px;
border:1px solid transparent;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:600}
.od .alert h4{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800}
.od .alert-danger{background:rgba(239,68,68,.13);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.3);color:#DC2626}
.od[data-dm="1"] .alert-danger{color:#F87171}
.od .alert-success{background:rgba(34,197,94,.13);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.3);color:#15803D}
.od[data-dm="1"] .alert-success{color:#4ADE80}
.od .alert .close{position:absolute;right:12px;top:11px;background:transparent;border:0;color:inherit;
opacity:.7;font-size:19px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 6px}

/* ══ RIGHT COLUMN ══ */
.od-side{border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--bd);overflow:hidden}
.od-side-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
.od-side-h>i{width:36px;height:36px;min-width:36px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);font-size:14px}
.od-side-h b{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc)}
.od-side-h small{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts)}
.od-side-b{padding:15px 18px 17px}

/* link cheat sheet */
.lk{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.lk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;
background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.lk-row>i{width:28px;height:28px;min-width:28px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:var(--sf);border:1px solid var(--ln);color:var(--p);font-size:12px}
.lk-row .w{flex:1;min-width:0}
.lk-row b{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc)}
.lk-row code{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;
color:var(--ts);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* order lifecycle */
.lc{position:relative;padding-left:30px}
.lc::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;top:9px;bottom:9px;width:2px;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ln),var(--bd))}
.lc-row{position:relative;padding-bottom:15px}
.lc-row:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.lc-row em{position:absolute;left:-30px;top:1px;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;font-style:normal;
display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:8.5px;color:#fff;z-index:1}
.lc-row em.q{background:#94A3B8}
.lc-row em.r{background:var(--ac)}
.lc-row em.g{background:var(--g)}
.lc-row em.b{background:var(--p)}
.lc-row b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--tc)}
.lc-row small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ts);line-height:1.6}

/* rules */
.rule{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;
background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--bd);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ts)}
.rule:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.rule b{color:var(--tc);font-weight:800}
.rule i{width:24px;height:24px;min-width:24px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;margin-top:1px}
.rule.no i{background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);color:#EF4444}
.rule.wr i{background:rgba(217,119,6,.14);color:var(--wr)}
.rule.ok i{background:rgba(34,197,94,.14);color:var(--ok)}
.rule.nt i{background:var(--sf);color:var(--p)}

/* support */
.sup{border-radius:18px;padding:22px 20px;text-align:center;background:var(--g);color:#fff}
.sup-ic{width:46px;height:46px;margin:0 auto 13px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);font-size:18px}
.sup b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800}
.sup small{display:block;margin:7px 0 15px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.sup a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:12px;
background:#fff;color:var(--p)!important;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;transition:.18s}
.sup a:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* ══ NO SHADOWS ══ */
.od,.od *,.od *::before,.od *::after{box-shadow:none!important}

/* ══ RESPONSIVE ══ */
@media(max-width:1280px){
.od{padding-left:20px!important;padding-right:20px!important}
}
@media(max-width:1150px){
.no-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
#avg-completed-times{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
#noc-filter{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:1000px){
.od{padding-left:18px!important;padding-right:18px!important}
}
@media(max-width:991px){
.od{min-height:calc(100vh - 150px);min-height:calc(100dvh - 150px);
padding-bottom:calc(90px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important}
}

/* ══ MOBILE ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FIX 6 (v2): the hero used to run well past a phone screen — 46px icons
stacked above the value, 24px of margin above the stats and 4 tall
blocks in a 2×2. Each tile is now a compact card with the icon beside
the number, which cuts the banner's height by roughly 40%.
The duplicate .od-stat / .od-stat>i declarations from v1 are gone. ══ */
@media(max-width:760px){
.od{padding-top:14px!important;padding-left:16px!important;padding-right:16px!important}
.od-hero{padding:20px 15px 18px;border-radius:18px}
.od-hero-bg{background-position:right -70px center}
.od-hero-scrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(255,255,255,.9) 60%,rgba(255,255,255,.82))}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-hero-scrim{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(16,9,12,.86),rgba(16,9,12,.78) 60%,rgba(16,9,12,.74))}
.od-hero-in{max-width:none;margin:0 auto}
.od-eyb{padding:5px 11px 5px 8px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em}
.od-eyb em{width:6px;height:6px}
.od-hero h1{margin:11px auto 6px;max-width:none;font-size:20px;line-height:1.25}
.od-hero p{max-width:none;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7}

/* compact stat cards — icon left, value + label right */
.od-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:16px;max-width:none}
.od-stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:2px 10px;align-items:center;
padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid var(--bd)!important;border-radius:13px;background:var(--field);text-align:left}
.od[data-dm="1"] .od-stat{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important}
.od-stat>i{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/3;width:34px;height:34px;min-width:34px;margin:0;border-radius:11px;font-size:13px}
.od-stat .v{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;font-size:14.5px;text-align:left}
.od-stat .k{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;margin-top:2px;font-size:9px;text-align:left;letter-spacing:.04em}

.od #template-input{padding-right:56px}
.od-sx .hint{display:none}
#avg-completed-times{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.od-rail{padding:14px}
/* logo only, four across, compact */
#noc-filter{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.noc-button{height:50px;padding:0;gap:0;border-radius:13px;justify-content:center}
.noc-button .icons{width:22px;height:22px;flex:0 0 22px}
.noc-button>i{font-size:18px}
.noc-button .filter_txt{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;
overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.od-spec{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.od-spec-row .v{max-width:60%}
.np-head{padding:16px 16px 0}
.np-body{padding:14px 16px 18px}
.no-sum{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.od-side-b{padding:14px 16px 16px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
.od{padding-left:14px!important;padding-right:14px!important}
.od-hero{padding:18px 13px 16px}
.od-hero h1{font-size:18.5px}
.od-hero p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65}
#noc-filter{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
}
@media(max-width:400px){
.od-stats{gap:7px}
.od-stat{padding:9px 9px;gap:2px 8px}
.od-stat>i{width:30px;height:30px;min-width:30px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px}
.od-stat .v{font-size:13px}
.od-stat .k{font-size:8.5px}
.noc-button{height:46px}
}
</style>

<div class="no-right">

<div class="od-side">
<div class="od-side-h">
<i class="fas fa-link"></i>
<div><b>Which link goes in the box</b><small>Paste the wrong one and it fails silently</small></div>
</div>
<div class="od-side-b">
<div class="lk">
<div class="lk-row"><i class="fas fa-user"></i><div class="w"><b>Followers &amp; subscribers</b><code>the profile or channel URL</code></div></div>
<div class="lk-row"><i class="fas fa-heart"></i><div class="w"><b>Likes, views &amp; saves</b><code>the single post or video URL</code></div></div>
<div class="lk-row"><i class="fas fa-comment"></i><div class="w"><b>Comments &amp; shares</b><code>the post URL, never the profile</code></div></div>
<div class="lk-row"><i class="fas fa-eye"></i><div class="w"><b>Story &amp; live views</b><code>the single post or video URL</code></div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="od-side">
<div class="od-side-h">
<i class="fas fa-route"></i>
<div><b>What happens after you send</b><small>The status you will see in My Orders</small></div>
</div>
<div class="od-side-b">
<div class="lc">
<div class="lc-row"><em class="q"><i class="fas fa-hourglass-half"></i></em><b>Pending</b><small>Accepted and queued. The charge is already held.</small></div>
<div class="lc-row"><em class="r"><i class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i></em><b>Processing</b><small>Handed to the provider, waiting for the first unit to land.</small></div>
<div class="lc-row"><em class="b"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i></em><b>In progress</b><small>Counting up. Remains shows what is still owed to you.</small></div>
<div class="lc-row"><em class="g"><i class="fas fa-check"></i></em><b>Completed or Partial</b><small>Partial refunds the undelivered share back to your balance.</small></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="od-side">
<div class="od-side-h">
<i class="fas fa-balance-scale"></i>
<div><b>House rules</b><small>Worth knowing before the first order</small></div>
</div>
<div class="od-side-b">
<div class="rule no"><i class="fas fa-ban"></i><span>Delivery is automated. Once a batch reaches the provider it <b>cannot be cancelled</b>.</span></div>
<div class="rule wr"><i class="fas fa-user-lock"></i><span>Going private, renaming or deleting the post <b>stops delivery</b> and voids the refill.</span></div>
<div class="rule nt"><i class="fas fa-layer-group"></i><span>A second order on the same link <b>waits in queue</b> behind the first one.</span></div>
<div class="rule ok"><i class="fas fa-undo"></i><span>Anything undelivered comes back to your <b>panel balance</b>, usually within minutes.</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="sup">
<div class="sup-ic"><i class="far fa-paper-plane"></i></div>
<b>Not sure which service fits?</b>
<small>Send the link and what you are after — we will point you at the right service ID instead of guessing.</small>
<a href="/tickets"><i class="fas fa-headset"></i> Ask support</a>
</div>

</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
var root=document.getElementById('odPage');if(!root)return;
var h=document.documentElement,b=document.body;

try{b.classList.add('od-live');}catch(e){}

/* ── theme follows the layout switcher ── */
function lum(str){
if(!str)return null;
str=str.trim();var r,g,bl,m;
if(str.charAt(0)==='#'){
var x=str.slice(1);
if(x.length===3)x=x[0]+x[0]+x[1]+x[1]+x[2]+x[2];
if(x.length<6)return null;
r=parseInt(x.substr(0,2),16);g=parseInt(x.substr(2,2),16);bl=parseInt(x.substr(4,2),16);
}else{
m=str.match(/[\d.]+/g);
if(!m||m.length<3)return null;
if(m[3]!==undefined&&parseFloat(m[3])<0.5)return null;
r=+m[0];g=+m[1];bl=+m[2];
}
return 0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*bl;
}
function themePick(){
var v=null;try{v=localStorage.getItem('lightMode');}catch(e){}
if(v==='light')return 'light';
if(v==='dark')return 'dark';
var cl=(' '+(h.className||'')+' '+(b.className||'')+' ').toLowerCase();
if(/\s(dark|dark-mode|darkmode|theme-dark|nightmode)\s/.test(cl))return 'dark';
if(/\s(light|light-mode|lightmode|theme-light)\s/.test(cl))return 'light';
var a=h.getAttribute('data-theme')||h.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')||
b.getAttribute('data-theme')||b.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')||'';
if(a==='dark'||a==='light')return a;
var L=lum(getComputedStyle(h).getPropertyValue('--main-bg'));
if(L===null)L=lum(getComputedStyle(b).getPropertyValue('--main-bg'));
if(L!==null)return L<90?'dark':'light';
return 'dark';
}
function paint(){
var d=themePick()==='dark'?'1':'0';
if(root.getAttribute('data-dm')===d&&h.getAttribute('data-oddm')===d)return;
root.setAttribute('data-dm',d);
h.setAttribute('data-oddm',d);
}
paint();
try{new MutationObserver(paint).observe(h,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','style','data-theme','data-bs-theme']});}catch(e){}
try{new MutationObserver(paint).observe(b,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','style','data-theme','data-bs-theme']});}catch(e){}
setInterval(paint,600);
window.addEventListener('pageshow',paint);
window.addEventListener('storage',paint);

/* ── platform rail: mark the pressed chip. The panel's own handler still runs,
this only adds the visual state it does not provide. ── */
var rail=document.getElementById('noc-filter');
if(rail){
rail.addEventListener('click',function(e){
var btn=e.target.closest('.noc-button');if(!btn)return;
rail.querySelectorAll('.noc-button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('active',x===btn);});
});
var first=rail.querySelector('.noc-button.default');
if(first)first.classList.add('active');
}

/* ── dismissible alerts ── */
root.addEventListener('click',function(e){
var c=e.target.closest('.alert .close');
if(c&&c.parentElement)c.parentElement.style.display='none';
});

/* ── service description → labelled spec tiles.
Rewrites the panel's own node in place, tags it .od-ready so we never
re-parse our own output, and pauses the observer during the write.
FIX 4 (v2): the old build ran findPanel() on a 300ms interval for the
whole session. The MutationObserver already catches every swap, so the
timer is now a slow safety net that exits immediately unless the
selected service actually changed. ── */
(function(){
var ICONS=[
[/link|url|username|profile/i,'fas fa-link'],
[/start/i,'fas fa-play'],
[/speed|per day|per hour/i,'fas fa-tachometer-alt'],
[/drop|refill|guarantee|warrant/i,'fas fa-shield-alt'],
[/time|duration|complete|eta/i,'far fa-clock'],
[/location|country|geo|target/i,'fas fa-globe'],
[/quality|real|type/i,'fas fa-gem'],
[/min\b|max\b|quantity|amount/i,'fas fa-boxes'],
[/price|cost|charge|rate/i,'fas fa-dollar-sign'],
[/note|info|important|read/i,'fas fa-info-circle']
];
function iconFor(k){
for(var i=0;i<ICONS.length;i++){if(ICONS[i][0].test(k))return ICONS[i][1];}
return 'fas fa-angle-right';
}
function esc(t){var d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=t;return d.innerHTML;}

function build(rawHtml){
if(!rawHtml||!rawHtml.trim())return '';
var text=rawHtml.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi,'\n')
.replace(/<\/(p|div|li|h[1-6])>/gi,'\n')
.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'')
.replace(/&nbsp;/gi,' ');
var d=document.createElement('textarea');d.innerHTML=text;text=d.value;
var lines=text.split('\n').map(function(l){return l.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
if(!lines.length)return '';

var rows='',notes=[],n=0;
lines.forEach(function(line){
var c=line.replace(/^[\-\u2013\u2014\u2022\*\s]+/,'').trim();
if(!c)return;
var ci=c.indexOf(':');
if(ci<0)ci=c.indexOf('：');
if(ci>1&&ci<38){
var label=c.slice(0,ci).trim(), value=c.slice(ci+1).trim();
if(value&&value.length<=90&&!/^[\u26a0\u2705\u2757\u2b50\ud83d\ud83c]/.test(c)){
n++;
rows+='<div class="od-spec-row'+(value.length>34?' wide':'')+'">'+
'<i class="'+iconFor(label)+'"></i>'+
'<span class="k">'+esc(label)+'</span>'+
'<span class="v">'+esc(value)+'</span></div>';
return;
}
}
notes.push(c);
});
if(!n)return '';

var html='<div class="od-spec">'+rows;
if(notes.length){
html+='<div class="od-note"><b><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i> Read before ordering</b><ul>';
notes.forEach(function(x){html+='<li>'+esc(x)+'</li>';});
html+='</ul></div>';
}
return html+'</div>';
}

function findPanel(){
var sels=['#desc-panel-body','#service_description .panel-body',
'#service_description .descriptions_full','#service_description .service_descriptions',
'.descriptions_full .panel-body','.descriptions_full','#service_description'];
for(var i=0;i<sels.length;i++){
var el=document.querySelector(sels[i]);
if(!el)continue;
if(el.querySelector('.od-spec')||el.querySelector('.od-note')){el.classList.add('od-ready');return null;}
var plain=(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
if(plain.length>3&&/[A-Za-z]{2,}\s*[:：]/.test(plain))return el;
if(plain.length>3){el.classList.add('od-ready');return null;} /* unstructured — show as-is */
}
return null;
}

var obs=null,busy=false;
function stopObs(){if(obs){obs.disconnect();obs=null;}}
function startObs(){
var host=document.getElementById('order-form')||document.querySelector('.no-left')||document.body;
if(!host||!window.MutationObserver)return;
obs=new MutationObserver(function(){render();});
obs.observe(host,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
}
function render(){
if(busy)return;
var el=findPanel();if(!el)return;
var out=build(el.innerHTML||'');
if(!out){el.classList.add('od-ready');return;}
busy=true;stopObs();
el.innerHTML=out;
el.classList.add('od-ready');
startObs();
setTimeout(function(){busy=false;},50);
}

var sel=document.getElementById('orderform-service');
if(sel)sel.addEventListener('change',function(){setTimeout(render,400);setTimeout(render,900);});

/* slow safety net — only does real work when the service id changed */
var lastSvc=sel?sel.value:'';
setInterval(function(){
var v=sel?sel.value:'';
if(v===lastSvc)return;
lastSvc=v;
render();
},700);

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){startObs();render();});
startObs();render();
})();

/* ── search by SERVICE ID.
The panel's own search only matches service names, so a bare ID returns nothing.
This walks the category list until the option turns up, then selects it. ── */
(function(){
var inp=document.getElementById('template-input');
var svc=document.getElementById('orderform-service');
var cat=document.getElementById('orderform-category');
var clr=document.getElementById('odSearchClear');
if(!inp||!svc)return;
var wrap=document.getElementById('new-order-search');

function fire(el){
var $=window.jQuery;
if($&&$.fn){try{$(el).trigger('change');return;}catch(e){}}
el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
}
function findOpt(id){
var o=svc.querySelector('option[value="'+id+'"]');
if(o)return o;
var list=svc.options;
for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){
if(new RegExp('(^|[^\\d])'+id+'([^\\d]|$)').test(list[i].textContent||''))return list[i];
}
return null;
}
function choose(o){svc.value=o.value;fire(svc);}

var hunting=false;
function huntAcrossCategories(id,done){
if(!cat||hunting)return done(false);
hunting=true;root.classList.add('od-hunting');
var opts=[].slice.call(cat.options),k=0,startCat=cat.value;
(function step(){
if(k>=opts.length){
cat.value=startCat;fire(cat);
hunting=false;root.classList.remove('od-hunting');return done(false);
}
var c=opts[k++];
cat.value=c.value;fire(cat);
var tries=0;
(function wait(){
var o=findOpt(id);
if(o){choose(o);hunting=false;root.classList.remove('od-hunting');return done(true);}
if(++tries>16)return setTimeout(step,40);
setTimeout(wait,110);
})();
})();
}

var t=null;
function go(){
var v=(inp.value||'').trim();
root.classList.toggle('od-searching',!!v);
if(!/^\d{2,}$/.test(v))return;
var o=findOpt(v);
if(o){choose(o);return;}
huntAcrossCategories(v,function(){});
}
inp.addEventListener('input',function(){clearTimeout(t);t=setTimeout(go,420);});
inp.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();clearTimeout(t);go();}
if(e.key==='Escape'){inp.value='';root.classList.remove('od-searching');}
});
if(clr)clr.addEventListener('click',function(){
inp.value='';root.classList.remove('od-searching');inp.focus();
if(wrap)fire(inp);
});
})();

/* ── active service count.
The panel exposes no Twig total for services, so it is counted once from the
services page (every row carries data-service-id) and cached for the session. ── */
(function(){
var out=document.getElementById('odSvcCount');
if(!out)return;
var KEY='wrSvcCount';
function show(n){out.textContent=n>0?Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US'):'—';}
try{
var c=sessionStorage.getItem(KEY);
if(c){show(parseInt(c,10));return;}
}catch(e){}
fetch('/services',{credentials:'same-origin'})
.then(function(r){return r.text();})
.then(function(html){
var doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');
var n=doc.querySelectorAll('[data-service-id]').length;
if(!n)n=doc.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-table-service-id]').length;
if(!n)return;
try{sessionStorage.setItem(KEY,String(n));}catch(e){}
show(n);
})
.catch(function(){});
})();

/* ── mirror the quantity into the summary tile.
The quantity input is injected into #fields by the panel, so watch for it. ── */
(function(){
var out=document.getElementById('total-amt');
var box=document.getElementById('fields');
if(!out||!box)return;
function qty(){
return box.querySelector('#quantity, input[name="OrderForm[quantity]"], input[name*="quantity" i], input[id*="quantity" i]');
}
function sync(){
var q=qty();
var v=q?(q.value||'').replace(/[^\d]/g,''):'';
out.textContent=v?parseInt(v,10).toLocaleString('en-US'):'0';
}
box.addEventListener('input',sync);
box.addEventListener('change',sync);
try{new MutationObserver(sync).observe(box,{childList:true,subtree:true});}catch(e){}
sync();
})();

/* ── RECENT COMPLETED TIME ──────────────────────────────────────
Fills #avg-completed-times from the stats API: the last six completed
orders for the selected service, shown as "4,400 = 15h 4m" pills, with
the average folded into the label.

The markup and styles for this block were already in the page but nothing
ever populated them, so the wrapper stayed hidden.

Select2 replaces the native select and does not always emit a plain
change event, so a 700ms poll on sel.value is the reliable trigger —
it exits immediately unless the service actually changed. ── */
(function(){
var API='https://service-uglj.onrender.com'; /* ← আপনার stats সার্ভারের ঠিকানা, শেষে / দেবেন না */
var LIMIT=6;

var wrap=document.getElementById('avg-completed-times-wrap');
var box=document.getElementById('avg-completed-times');
var lab=wrap&&wrap.querySelector('.form-label');
var sel=document.getElementById('orderform-service');
if(!wrap||!box||!sel)return;

var LABEL='<i class="fas fa-stopwatch"></i> Recent completed time';
var cache={},last=null,req=0;

function esc(t){var d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=t;return d.innerHTML;}
function num(n){return Number(n||0).toLocaleString('en-US');}
function hide(){wrap.style.display='none';}

function skeleton(){
var h='';
for(var i=0;i<LIMIT;i++)h+='<span class="od-skel-i"></span>';
box.innerHTML=h;
if(lab)lab.innerHTML=LABEL;
wrap.style.display='';
}

function paint(d){
var pills='';
((d&&d.recent)||[]).forEach(function(r){
if(!r.completed_in)return;
pills+='<span class="badge">'+num(r.quantity)+' = '+esc(r.completed_in)+'</span>';
});
if(!pills)return hide(); /* এই সার্ভিসে এখনো সম্পন্ন অর্ডার নেই */
box.innerHTML=pills;
if(lab){
lab.innerHTML=LABEL+(d.average_time
? ' <span class="od-avg">· avg '+esc(d.average_time)+'</span>' : '');
}
wrap.style.display='';
}

function load(){
var id=(sel.value||'').trim();
if(id===last)return;
last=id;
if(!id)return hide();
if(cache[id]!==undefined)return paint(cache[id]);

skeleton();
var n=++req;
fetch(API+'/api/orders/completed/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'?limit='+LIMIT)
.then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():null;})
.then(function(d){if(n===req){cache[id]=d;paint(d);}})
.catch(function(){if(n===req)hide();});
}

sel.addEventListener('change',function(){setTimeout(load,60);});
var $=window.jQuery;
if($&&$.fn){try{$(sel).on('change',function(){setTimeout(load,60);});}catch(e){}}
setInterval(load,700);
load();
})();
})();
</script>

<script>
var userSpent = 0;
if (userSpent <= 500) {
var userlevel = "Basic";
} else if (userSpent > 500 && userSpent <= 2000) {
var userlevel = "Standard";
} else if (userSpent > 2000 && userSpent <= 5000) {
var userlevel = "Plus";
} else if (userSpent > 5000 && userSpent <= 10000) {
var userlevel = "Premium";
} else if (userSpent > 10000 && userSpent <= 25000) {
var userlevel = "Elite";
} else if (userSpent > 25000) {
var userlevel = "Ultimate";
}
var placer = document.getElementById("placePercent");
var progress = document.getElementById("statusProgress");
var currentStatus = document.getElementById("currentStatus");
var nextStatus = document.getElementById("nextStatus");
var remain = document.getElementById("remain");
switch (userlevel) {
case "Basic":
var cal = userSpent / 5;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Basic';
nextStatus.innerText = 'Standard';
break;
case "Standard":
var userSpent = userSpent;
var cal = userSpent / 20;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Standard';
nextStatus.innerText = 'Plus';
break;
case "Plus":
var userSpent = userSpent;
var cal = userSpent / 50;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Plus';
nextStatus.innerText = 'Premium';
break;
case "Premium":
var userSpent = userSpent;
var cal = userSpent / 100;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Premium';
nextStatus.innerText = 'Elite';
break;
case "Elite":
var userSpent = userSpent;
var cal = userSpent / 250;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Premium';
nextStatus.innerText = 'Elite';
break;
case "Ultimate":
var cal = 100;
progress.setAttribute("style", "width:" + cal + "%;");
placer.innerText = cal + "%";
currentStatus.innerText = 'Ultimate';
nextStatus.innerText = '--';
break;
default:
placer.innerHTML = `<b style="color:red">ERR%</b>`;
currentStatus.innerHTML = `<b style="color:red">no data found.</b>`;
nextStatus.innerHTML = `<b style="color:red">n/a</b>`;
remain.innerHTML = `<b style="color:red">n/a</b>`;
}
var getText = document.getElementById("placePercent").innerText;
var parse = parseInt(getText);
document.getElementById("placePercent").innerText = parse + '%';
var getTextSaldo = document.getElementById("saldo").innerText;
var semr = getTextSaldo.replace('R$ ', '');
var splitDividir = parseFloat(semr).toFixed(2);
document.getElementById("saldo").innerText = 'R$ ' + splitDividir;
try{ var _c=document.getElementById("accLevelChip"); if(_c){_c.innerText=(currentStatus.innerText||'Member');} }catch(e){}
</script>

<!-- ==== currency change works on ALL pages (single reload) ==== -->
<script>
(function(){
var busy=false;
function home(){return location.pathname==='/'||location.pathname===''}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
var t=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.currency-option');
if(!t||home()||busy)return;
e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();busy=true;
var k=t.getAttribute('data-rate-key');
var f=document.createElement('iframe');
f.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:0;height:0;border:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none';
f.src='/';
var done=false;
function finish(){if(done)return;done=true;location.reload();}
f.onload=function(){
try{
var d=f.contentDocument;
var a=d.querySelector('#currencies-list .currency-option[data-rate-key="'+k+'"]');
if(a){a.click();setTimeout(finish,1200);}else{finish();}
}catch(_){finish();}
};
setTimeout(finish,6000);
document.body.appendChild(f);
},true);
})();
</script>

<!-- ==== currency pill sync (symbol + code, persists on change) ==== -->
<script>
(function(){
var LS='tg_cur';
function el(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function saved(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}
function pick(){
var list=document.querySelectorAll('#currencies-list .currency-option');
if(!list.length)return null;
var s=saved();
if(s&&s.k){
var m=document.querySelector('#currencies-list .currency-option[data-rate-key="'+s.k+'"]');
if(m)return m;
}
return document.querySelector('#currencies-list .currency-option.active')||list[0];
}
function sync(){
var a=pick(),cs=el('curSym'),cc=el('curCode');
if(!a||!cs||!cc)return;
cs.textContent=a.getAttribute('data-rate-symbol')||'$';
cc.textContent=a.getAttribute('data-rate-key')||'USD';
document.querySelectorAll('#currencies-list .currency-option').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active')});
a.classList.add('active');
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
var t=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.currency-option');
if(!t)return;
try{localStorage.setItem(LS,JSON.stringify({k:t.getAttribute('data-rate-key'),s:t.getAttribute('data-rate-symbol')}))}catch(_){}
setTimeout(sync,60);
},true);
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',sync);
[200,600,1400].forEach(function(t){setTimeout(sync,t)});
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Warrior: lock page scroll while mobile dropdown sheet is open */
(function(){
function mob(){return window.innerWidth<=767}
function lock(on){document.body.classList.toggle('dd-open',!!on);document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dd-open',!!on);}
function anyOpen(){return !!document.querySelector('.ui-dropdown .dropdown-menu.show,.ui-dropdown.show .dropdown-menu');}
function sync(){lock(mob()&&anyOpen());}
document.addEventListener('click',function(){setTimeout(sync,30)},true);
try{new MutationObserver(sync).observe(document.body,{subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}catch(e){}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(!mob())lock(false)});
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
var PT=null, scanned=false, tBusy=false;

function isOurs(el){ return !!(el.closest && (el.closest('.wtog')||el.closest('.header')||el.closest('.main-header')||el.closest('.sidebar')||el.closest('.dd-menu'))); }

function findPageToggle(){
if(scanned) return PT;
scanned=true;
var best=null;
try{
var all=document.body.querySelectorAll('*');
for(var i=0;i<all.length;i++){
var el=all[i];
if(isOurs(el)) continue;
var cs=window.getComputedStyle(el);
if(cs.position!=='fixed') continue;
var t=(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
if(t==='dark'||t==='light'||t==='dark mode'||t==='light mode'){
best=el; /* keep last (innermost-ish) */
}
}
}catch(e){}
PT=best;
if(PT){ PT.setAttribute('data-w-hidden','1'); }
return PT;
}

function applyOwn(t){
try{ localStorage.setItem('lightMode',t); localStorage.setItem('theme',t); localStorage.setItem('sw_theme','v5'); }catch(e){}
var h=document.documentElement;
h.className=t; h.setAttribute('data-theme',t); h.setAttribute('data-bs-theme',t);
if(document.body){ document.body.classList.remove('dark','light','dark-mode','light-mode'); document.body.classList.add(t); }
if(typeof changeTheme==='function'){ try{ changeTheme(t); }catch(e){} }
}

/* PACK 11 : single-fire guard — stops the double-click / flash on guest header */
window.wTheme=function(){
if(tBusy) return;
tBusy=true;
setTimeout(function(){ tBusy=false; },450);

var p=findPageToggle();
if(p){ try{ p.click(); }catch(e){}
setTimeout(function(){
var isDark=document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')||document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark';
try{ localStorage.setItem('lightMode',isDark?'dark':'light'); }catch(e){}
},60);
return;
}
var d=document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
var t=d?'light':'dark';
applyOwn(t);
[140,340].forEach(function(ms){ setTimeout(function(){ applyOwn(t); },ms); });
};

function setVH(){
var h = (window.visualViewport && window.visualViewport.height) ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wvh', (h*0.01)+'px');
}
setVH();
window.addEventListener('resize',setVH);
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){ setTimeout(setVH,250); });
if(window.visualViewport){ window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',setVH); }
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',setVH);

function syncStore(){
try{
var h=document.documentElement, b=document.body;
var dark = h.classList.contains('dark') || h.getAttribute('data-theme')==='dark'
|| (b&&(b.classList.contains('dark')||b.classList.contains('dark-mode')));
localStorage.setItem('lightMode', dark?'dark':'light');
}catch(e){}
}
window.wSyncTheme=syncStore;
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){ setTimeout(findPageToggle,300); setTimeout(syncStore,600); });
window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(syncStore,400); setTimeout(syncStore,1200); });
document.addEventListener('click',function(){ setTimeout(syncStore,250); },true);

/* account panel : make sure the identity row is never empty */
function paintAcc(){
var m=document.getElementById('home-settings');
if(!m) return;
m.scrollTop=0;
var r=m.querySelector('.acc-id-row');
if(r){
var nEl=r.querySelector('.acc-name'), mEl=r.querySelector('.acc-mail');
if(nEl && !nEl.textContent.trim()) nEl.textContent = r.getAttribute('data-name')||'Account';
if(mEl && !mEl.textContent.trim()) mEl.textContent = r.getAttribute('data-mail')||'';
r.style.setProperty('display','flex','important');
r.style.setProperty('opacity','1','important');
r.style.setProperty('visibility','visible','important');
}
var lab=m.querySelector('.wtog-label');
if(lab){
var dk=document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
lab.textContent = dk ? 'Dark' : 'Light';
}
void m.offsetHeight;
}
window.wPaintAcc=paintAcc;

function watchAcc(){
var m=document.getElementById('home-settings');
if(!m) return false;
paintAcc();
try{
new MutationObserver(function(){ paintAcc(); setTimeout(paintAcc,20); })
.observe(m,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','style']});
}catch(e){}
var btn=document.getElementById('dropdownAccount');
if(btn){
['pointerdown','mousedown','click','touchstart'].forEach(function(ev){
btn.addEventListener(ev,function(){ [0,10,40,120,260].forEach(function(ms){ setTimeout(paintAcc,ms); }); },true);
});
}
return true;
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
if(!watchAcc()){ var n=0,t=setInterval(function(){ if(watchAcc()||++n>40) clearInterval(t); },150); }
});
window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(paintAcc,300); });
window.addEventListener('load',function(){ scanned=false; findPageToggle(); });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
